correctness.rationale: The 64 possible order-three words have eight negative-reverse fixed points and 28 nonfixed two-element orbits. The quotient de Bruijn multigraph has ten vertices, 28 edges and exactly six odd-degree vertices. An admissible cyclic position code projects to a closed trail of distinct quotient edges, forcing at least three omitted edges. The only two parity-correcting triples of omissions are {001,032,122} and {003,012,221}; a negative-reversal-invariant two-letter coboundary has residual cyclic flux -2 and +2 respectively, so neither can support a 25-edge trail. The explicitly listed 24-symbol cyclic code has 24 distinct, nonfixed, pairwise negative-reverse-inequivalent windows. Exact code regenerates and verifies the whole finite graph and witness.
